Migrated 9 files to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, 3 call sites each.

`vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` still uses `db.query`, left alone. It's a vendored file marked "do not edit — replaced wholesale on every upgrade."

`cache.query` calls in several repo files are unrelated, not touched.

All `db.query` call sites outside vendor are now gone.
